purpose: Shared non-theological navigation labels for historical authors and future separately attributed public commentaries, including Jake if authorized.

notation.nonverse: P is a non-Scripture navigation namespace, never verse 0.

reader_default: Display verse and verse-range entries only; list P navigation separately with explicit selection.
source_boundary_rule: Retain immutable original SWORD/HelloAO source record, include source IDs and character-span locator for derived sections; never infer verse coverage from adjacency.
future_author_contract: Expose author_id, display_name, life_dates, geographic_association, work_publication, creator_type, rights, provenance, approval_status when applicable. Do not treat commissioned Jake drafts as published or historical speech.
